sources.title: 朱翌《猗覺寮雜記》卷下：李虛中及生時
sources.url: https://zh.wikisource.org/zh-hant/猗覺寮雜記_(四庫全書本)/卷下
sources.quality_notes: Paragraph beginning 李虛中; contrasts his reputed lack of birth hour with contemporary hour use, reports transmission loss and criticizes accuracy. Authorial retrospective, not Tang direct witness or proof of empirical efficacy.

sources.title: 《猗覺寮雜記》識典正文及十二宮段
sources.quality_notes: Birth-hour paragraph and twelve-palace paragraph at https://www.shidianguji.com/zh/mid-page/7621307227416870921; latter contains obvious transcription corruption and uncertain Fude palace number, not adjudicated. Two access locations for one received text object, not independent physical witness.

sources.title: 《猗覺寮雜記》二卷 鮑氏本館目
sources.quality_notes: Tokyo University Institute for Advanced Studies on Asia holding, Qing Qianlong–Daoguang Bao printing cataloged; no folio examined or Song original established.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Song retrospective does not prove Tang Li Xuzhong omitted hour in all practice
Twelve-palace astral practice is not proof of fourteen-main-star Ziwei
Two received access routes do not establish independent physical witnesses
unresolved_lineage_questions: Authenticated earlier folios and exact palace ordinal
Independent early mechanical evidence for transition to day-master Ziping and Ziwei
